name: Conquering Arathi Basin
summary: A Horde Warbringer asks you for three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor. Bring them from the battleground to the warbringer outside it.

sections.title: A Warbringer's Request
sections.body: The warbringer waits outside the battlegrounds, where you can bring the marks. You are asked to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to the Horde.

faq.q: What does the Horde Warbringer want?
faq.answer: The Horde Warbringer asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Where do I bring the marks?
faq.answer: Bring the marks to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

faq.q: How many Marks of Honor are needed?
faq.answer: You are asked to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Which marks does the warbringer ask for?
faq.answer: The request is for Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

attribution: In-game quest text: Conquering Arathi Basin
